gatewayBridge: dsh_spike_m4.c (JNI, sibling of dsh_spike_jni.c): descriptor before eval, gateway dispatch + bus sink before eval, eval + first pump on the calling thread; settle/event/bus-deliver re-entry hopped by Kotlin onto the single HandlerThread('dsh-spike-js'); primitive handlers run on the UI thread (dialogs/picker), fetch worker threads, and the notification manager — never on the runtime thread
